Topic.label: Views from Different Directions and Nets of Solid Figures

Question:
What shapes are obtained when an upright cylinder is viewed from the front and from above, respectively?

[Figure 1](figures/cnm_051_q2_question_en.svg)
Solution: An upright cylinder appears as a rectangle from the front and as the circle of its base from above.
